__baseline_prompt__.text: An investigative-fiction scene, photographed as one plausible moment in a financial-investigation workroom: a person engaged in an investigation is examining records to test a suspected connection. Use the supplied portrait as the face and hair appearance reference. Preserve the visible facial appearance from the supplied portrait. Preserve the visible short dark bob and wispy fringe from the supplied portrait. The investigator sits at a working desk, attentive to a paper deposit statement and a nearby screen displaying a funds-flow diagram. The screen's connected account boxes end at a clearly readable final recipient A-17 with the amount 9,800,000; the paper's final recipient row clearly reads A-17 and 9,800,000, enclosed together by one red oval. The investigator's right hand holds the pencil, its graphite point physically touching the circled A-17 / 9,800,000 entry on the paper deposit statement. The pencil has a continuous slim shaft ending in a sharpened graphite writing point. The investigator's left hand separately supports the paper at its outer edge, with both hands visibly connected to their own forearms. Place the actual pencil point on the final printed zero inside that oval, with a tiny contact shadow joining the point to the paper. The contact and the full circled row occupy the open foreground. The right fingers hold the shaft well back from the sharpened point, leaving the complete point-to-print junction exposed. The paper rests at a shallow incline; the left fingers brace its far edge and keep the circled entry clear. A low, tilted screen sits immediately beside the statement, orienting its final account box toward the same viewing position. The investigator's three-quarter face rises behind this paired evidence, gaze lowered toward the contact and lips quietly parted in concentration. Their presence has a subtle natural warmth, while the joined point and matching records carry the photograph. The camera views the desk from a modestly elevated oblique position, placing the circled row and final screen node near each other in depth. Use sufficient focus for the point, both matching labels, the distinct hands and the reference-guided face to remain legible together. A broad desk lamp casts soft lateral light across matte paper, the fine pencil edge and the face. A ledger folder recedes behind the working area, giving the close action a restrained financial-investigation context.
